title: The Master Said to Me
tagline: Host one Babylonian evening meal and survive it: patrol the fields at dusk, wash three kinds of waters correctly, wait out the cheese after meat, wipe with the one bread Rabbi Zeira allows, guard your crumbs from the angel of poverty, sink the foam, untie the gardener's bundle, and keep the wine barrel out from under the gutter demon
mechanic: hazard-navigation dinner simulator — an eleven-scene choose-your-action evening meal scored on three meters (guf/body, mamon/purse, ruach/spirit) where every choice is resolved by the daf's actual rulings (Rav Chisda's meat-then-cheese ban, Rabbi Zeira's wiping-bread tests, the first/middle/final waters baraita, Sodomite salt, the held-cup limits), with a signature flip-card after each of Abaye's eight traditions that turns his assumed mundane reason over to reveal Rabba's hidden one (evil spirit, poverty angel, witchcraft, demons), graded on Mar Ukva's vinegar-son-of-wine scale

title: The Angel Who Never Sang
tagline: Stage the angel's grip to see which thigh Yaakov lost, match five Sages to the five verses that keep a scholar indoors after dark, measure the ladder at eight thousand parasangs, and re-cut the angels' Kedushah until the Divine Name lands where the baraita allows it
mechanic: top-down staging puzzle placing the angel in the three real positions the Sages reconstruct (face-to-face hug per Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi and Rashi, at Yaakov's right hand per Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani's gentile and Rava bar Ulla's Torah scholar, or up from behind per the Rabbis) and reading off which thigh each blocking strikes, a five-verse/five-Sage single-use assignment of the sources for a Torah scholar not going out alone at night (Rabbi Yitzchak, Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, Rabbi Abbahu, the Rabbis, Rav), an evidence-dial derivation of the ladder's 8,000-parasang width from the plural of olim/yordim and Tarshish's 2,000, and a Kedushah composer where the player adds and removes kadoshes across three angelic companies until Rav Chananel's 1/1/1 becomes the Gemara's emended 1/2/3, validated live against the baraita's rule that angels may not utter the Name before three words, plus a seven-stop dial through the disputed frequency of the angels' song

title: Larger Than Life
tagline: Catch the Mishnah itself exaggerating across the ash-mound, golden vine, and Curtain, route seven real sciatic-nerve cases through the altar's back rooms, and follow the Gemara's own back-and-forth over whether Rabbi Yehuda was certain or just guessing
mechanic: spot-the-exaggeration reveal across three real Mishnayot (ash-mound, golden vine, Curtain) per Rabbi Yitzchak bar Nachmani/Shmuel's three guzma cases, a routing puzzle sending the sciatic nerve of burnt/peace offerings to their correct real destination (altar ash-mound vs. courtyard drain) per Rav Huna and the Rabbis, and a locked step-by-step reveal of the Gemara's certain-vs-unsure back-and-forth over Rabbi Yehuda's thigh ruling

title: Dust and Ashes
tagline: Sort sixteen real substances into what covers slaughtered blood and what doesn't, get stranded without earth once in the desert and once on a ship, and meet Beit Hillel and Beit Shammai's fight over whether ash even counts as dust
mechanic: substance sorting game (16 real mishna/baraita items dragged into 'covers'/'does not cover' bins, checked against the min-afar category and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's grows-plants rule) + a desert/ship stranded-without-earth scenario picker (grind a gold dinar or burn your garment for ash) + a sage-position quiz on the dam hanitaz machloket + closing flip-cards on the Beit Hillel/Beit Shammai ash-is-afar dispute and Rava's aggada about Avraham's dust and ashes

title: One Covering for All
tagline: A deaf-mute, an imbecile, or a minor slaughters unsupervised — fill in Rebbi's real verdict grid, test whether a purity shortcut transfers to forbidden meat, then run animals through one covering pit and watch Rabbi Yehuda split it in two
mechanic: predict-and-reveal verdict grid (2×3 table exposing that the Rabbis actually dispute both clauses of the mishna, not just the one the plain text shows) + true/false twist cards flipping who's really lenient vs. stringent + a mi'ut/chazakah rule-transplant test + a group-and-seal sequencing toy (drop chaya/of tokens into a shared covering under the Rabbis' rule, or under Rabbi Yehuda's order-constrained split)

title: The Redacted Rabbis
tagline: Unmask which sage is hiding behind "the Rabbis" in two mirror-image mishnayot, catch each one's one real exception, and help Rabbi Chiyya outwit the moths in his flax
mechanic: redacted-ruling unmasking (reveal evidence chips, then accuse Rabbi Meir or Rabbi Shimon of hiding behind the mishnah's anonymous "the Rabbis" across two mirror-image rulings on unfit slaughter) + true/false loophole cards testing each sage's one real concession + a branching how-do-you-get-the-blood puzzle from Rabbi Chiyya's moth-eaten flax

title: The Stewpot Ledger
tagline: Slide your fortune from a hundred dinars to ten thousand and watch Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya's stewpot fill — then guess the bracket for six purses, diagnose a cup of lukewarm water, and flip five household maxims from Proverbs
mechanic: wealth-bracket resource simulator + predict-the-tier quiz (drag a log-scale dinar slider through Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya's four stewpot brackets, then guess the right pot and frequency for six purses) plus a branching diagnose-your-cup wizard for Rabbi Yochanan's lukewarm-water rule and a flip-card gallery of five Proverbs-derived household maxims

title: The Litter Ledger
tagline: A firstling drops its afterbirth, a consecrated ewe drops hers — split a hundred births into buckets and watch the majority decide their fate
mechanic: population majority scale (drag a genuine miut anywhere in range and watch Rav Ika's rov/miut bucket-arithmetic hold; toggle firstling vs. consecrated litters to flip which bucket wins)

title: The Convergence Gauge
tagline: Feel out which cords count as the convergence of sinews, then flip switches on three strands and watch Ameimar and Mar bar Rav Ashi disagree in real time
mechanic: diagnostic classifier + live dual-rule strand calculator (sort specimens by Abaye's four tests, then toggle three strands and watch two amoraic AND/OR formulas diverge)

title: The Warning Cry
tagline: Eight slaughters, one day — cry the hatra'ah only at the moment, and about the charge, that makes the lashes stick
mechanic: forewarning timeline (cry or hold your peace at each moment of a day's slaughters; hatra'at safek strikes doubtful cries)

title: The Koy Pen
tagline: Two hybrid kids, two different mothers — sort six real rulings into the right pen, then meet five sages who can't agree what a koy even is
mechanic: sort/spot-the-difference (assign six of Rav Pappa's real rulings to the correct sire×dam pen) + sage-to-claim matching + step-through objection volley

title: The Rispak Stables
tagline: Rabbi Abba wants mules for his wagon — listen to each bray, measure ears and tails, and harness only the ones that match
mechanic: siman inspection (hear synthesized brays, read ears & tails, yoke matching mules; koy-gate epilogue)

title: The Sealed Dockets
tagline: Seven verdict records survived the archive; set the four dials and reconstruct the cases of Oto v'et Beno
mechanic: inverse deduction (read the verdict stamps, set dials to reconstruct the case)

title: The Herdbook Lens
tagline: One womb-born kid becomes a three-generation herd — swing the lens of four poskim over the flock, stamp every page, and outrun the bear
mechanic: posek lens (swing rulings-lenses over one womb-born herd and stamp who needs the knife)

title: The Five-Year Lamb
tagline: Shepherd the ben pekuah from the womb to five years plowing the field — at every waypoint, is it one animal or part of another?
mechanic: waypoint trail (escort one creature through nine stations of its halakhic biography)

title: The Phantom Knife
tagline: Six scenes, one blade that never touches anything: click where the halakhic cut falls
mechanic: phantom-knife scene cuts (place the halakhic cut on an SVG scene, or keep it sheathed)

title: The Severed Link
tagline: Forge four chains of the daf's reasoning, link by link, in the smithy of Pumbedita
mechanic: chain-forging (pick the next link to rebuild the sugya's reasoning)

title: The Swallowed Ring
tagline: You are the posek: rule tamei or tahor on ten real cases of encapsulated impurity
